description: Updates all references to the specified item to point to a new provided in the -NewTarget or removes links to the item.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

id.description: The ID of the item to be relinked. Supply this or path.

newTarget.description: The path to a new item the links should be pointing to.

path.description: The path of the item to be relinked. Supply this or id.

removeLink.description: Removes all links to the current target item.

name: common-update-item-referrer
